# Anicca (aniccaai.com)

> Indie apps and small products by Daisuke Narita, Tokyo. The main product is Anicca, a free-to-download iPhone affirmation app that sends one short, honest line at the time of day you choose, with no streaks. Pages on this site are plain text and free to quote.

## Apps
- [Anicca: Daily Affirmations (iPhone)](https://aniccaai.com/affirmation-app): one short affirmation at the time you pick, 13 self-care topics, no streaks. Free to download, optional subscription. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755129214
- [Honne (iPhone)](https://aniccaai.com/honne): paste a text message you received and Honne's AI suggests the feeling likely behind it and drafts a reply that won't make things worse. Free: 3 analyses a day; optional Premium. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759667221
- [Thankful (iPhone)](https://aniccaai.com/thankful): a simple gratitude app. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759514159
- [Daily Dhamma (iPhone)](https://aniccaai.com/dailydharma): read Dhammapada verses, bookmark passages and set mindfulness reminders. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/daily-dhamma/id6757726663
- [Sleep Reset (iPhone)](https://aniccaai.com/sleepreset): get a free sleep reset score and recovery outlook. Personalized plans, bedtime timing and guided breathwork require a paid subscription. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/for-better-sleep-sleep-reset/id6762143790
- [STUDIO CHERIE (iPhone)](https://aniccaai.com/studio-cherie): 服・靴・小物を写真で登録し、手持ちの服から着こなしを考える。気になるコーデの保存や、新しい服の組み合わせの試行、Resting Boxでの整理にも。 App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/studio-cherie/id6766485903
- [BreathCalm (iPhone, App Store listing pending)](https://aniccaai.com/breath-calm): guided breathing (4-7-8, Box, Coherent) with binaural audio and an SOS mode.
- [CalmCortisol (iPhone, coming soon)](https://aniccaai.com/calmcortisol): 60-second breathing sessions to reset the nervous system. Not yet on the App Store.

## Free tools
- [Mind Habits Quiz](https://aniccaai.com/affirmation-app/en/quiz): free 12-question quiz (about 2 minutes) that maps you to one of 8 mind-habit types, with a type note and one line to try tonight. Not a medical diagnosis.
- [心のクセ診断 (Japanese quiz)](https://aniccaai.com/affirmation-app/ja/shindan)
